verdicts.reason: Fragments show mm_all_locks_mutex, free_vmap_area_lock, vmap_purge_lock serializing lazy purge in drain_vmap_area_work, and smp_wmb() in clear_vm_uninitialized_flag pairing with readers.
pgt_entry spans PMD/PUD levels; however vma_remap_struct definition is omitted, folio_referenced_arg holds counts/flags not extents, and mfill_state fragment is missing.
vma_find/vma_next/vma_prev provide bounded/forward/backward iteration; vma_lookup uses mtree_load; zap_vma covers the VMA range; stub handle_userfault returns VM_FAULT_SIGBUS.
folio_get/get_page/unpin_user_pages warn/bug on bad refs, tlb_needs_table_invalidate is true, and __pte_offset_map rejects trans_huge PMDs; lost reserve bits and no-MMU faults are not in fragments.

overall: Findings 5 and 7 are well supported by the cited fragments. Findings 6 and 8 are partially supported due to missing struct definitions/fragments and claims (extents, reserve bits, no-MMU faults) not evidenced in the provided code.
